resources.string: Your habits, one commit at a time.
A repo is a habit you choose. A commit records progress toward its target, including partial progress.
Start with an empty workspace on this device. No account or connection is needed. Your optional profile and preferences live in Settings.

GitHabit keeps your workspace on this device, without accounts or cloud sync. Uninstalling erases local data. Exports are plaintext and a chosen document provider may sync them independently. Import is not yet available in this build.
